scope: apartment resident/tenant experiences and generalized buyer-platform research

categories.vi: Tiếng ồn, tiện ích và môi trường

objective_protocol.dedupe_rule: one household/tenant, one time-window signal per topic; no identifiable account details
objective_protocol.fraud_moderation: exclude incentivized reviews, conflict disclosed, no anonymous unverifiable mass scores
objective_protocol.publication_rule: no aggregated score until sample threshold and source-mix documented

editorial_market_signals.subject: HCMC new platform-wide apartment search share
editorial_market_signals.qualifier: Demand/search share, NOT positive resident feedback, NOT satisfaction, and no score for any particular project.

disclaimer: Zero project user ratings is the accurate result until properly deduplicated, consent/privacy-safe and independently verified input is available. No fabricated 4.5-star condo reviews.
